assessments.description:
Reentrancy in ZZZLiquidityManager._swapExact(bytes32,PoolConfig,bool,uint256,uint256,address,uint256,MarketState) (src/ZZZLiquidityManager.sol#246-265):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- _executionOracle().beforeSwap(address(poolManager),address(stateView),poolId,expected) (src/ZZZLiquidityManager.sol#259)
	Balance read before the call:
	- beforeOutput = _balance(output,recipient) (src/ZZZLiquidityManager.sol#256)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- pendingSwapHash != bytes32(0) || amountOut < minimumOut || _balance(output,recipient) != beforeOutput + amountOut (src/ZZZLiquidityManager.sol#261-262)
		- stale variable `beforeOutput`
assessments.rationale: beforeOutput is the deliberate pre-swap recipient snapshot. Private _swapExact runs within nonReentrant swap/balance, arms one exact pending payload hash, and calls the current Manager-only Oracle beforeSwap full-frame check. Its final equality requires recipient gain to equal amountOut; callback-induced balance drift reverts rather than being trusted for later spending. This assumes separately admitted immutable core/token dependencies.

	External calls:
	- output = ZZZLPRewardConverter(address(converter)).convert(token,total,routeId,minimumETH,deadline) (src/ZZZRewards.sol#198)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- directCollective[ids[i_scope_0]][address(0)] += sharedETH (src/ZZZRewards.sol#216)
	ZZZExactLPRewardsCanonical.directCollective (src/base/ZZZExactLPRewardsCanonical.sol#49) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- ZZZExactLPRewardsCanonical.canonicalSeed(uint256) (src/base/ZZZExactLPRewardsCanonical.sol#129-138)
	- ZZZRewards.claimableComponents(uint256,address) (src/ZZZRewards.sol#123-131)
	- directIndividual[ids[i_scope_0]][address(0)] += ownETH (src/ZZZRewards.sol#215)
	ZZZExactLPRewardsCanonical.directIndividual (src/base/ZZZExactLPRewardsCanonical.sol#48) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- ZZZExactLPRewardsCanonical.canonicalSeed(uint256) (src/base/ZZZExactLPRewardsCanonical.sol#129-138)
	- ZZZRewards.claimableComponents(uint256,address) (src/ZZZRewards.sol#123-131)
	- directLiabilities[address(0)] += output (src/ZZZRewards.sol#203)
	ZZZExactLPRewardsCanonical.directLiabilities (src/base/ZZZExactLPRewardsCanonical.sol#50) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- ZZZExactLPRewardsCanonical.directLiabilities (src/base/ZZZExactLPRewardsCanonical.sol#50)
	- liabilities[address(0)] += output (src/ZZZRewards.sol#202)
	ZZZExactLPRewardsCanonical.liabilities (src/base/ZZZExactLPRewardsCanonical.sol#44) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- ZZZExactLPRewardsCanonical.liabilities (src/base/ZZZExactLPRewardsCanonical.sol#44)
assessments.prior_exact_fingerprint_rationale: convertBatch clears source rights and debits source liability before conversion, then assigns exact received ETH by cumulative whole floors. nonReentrant rejects claims/credit/sync/conversion; claimableComponents, allocationTree and canonicalSeed read barriers reject intermediate accounting. Public mapping reads alone authorize no economic write; external token behavior is qualified separately.
assessments.rationale: convertBatch holds the shared Rewards nonReentrant guard; competing claims/credits/sync/canonical writes are guarded. Source components/liability are removed before fixed-ledger converter execution, and exact token decrease/native increase are required before adding same-NFT ETH credits and checking solvency. Claimable and canonical views explicitly reject an entered guard. Public aggregate getters may expose temporary read-only values but grant no mutating reentry path.
